posts.text:
Good news. 

E. Jean Carroll spent a decade in court fighting one of the most powerful men in the world.

She fought with tenacity and grace — and she won. She is one of my personal heroes.

We owe her a debt of gratitude.

https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/trump-supreme-court-e-jean-carroll.html
posts.summary: Praises E. Jean Carroll's legal victory against Trump, calls her a hero
